Grader

/teach/courses/:courseId/grading/:assessmentId/receipts/:receiptId
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S17

Review an immutable received attempt with question-specific scoring and comments, preserving manual overrides and held revisions.

Entry and return
W48 queueW51 gradebook cellW54 correction review
Layout regions
Roster/question pickerAllocated learner/group receipts and stable question IDs
DocumentOriginal pages, page tags, accessible download and receipt metadata
Score panelPinned rubric, manual override reason, comments, per-question save and review checklist

Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • At wide widths use roster, document and score panes; around 1240px app width collapse roster to labelled picker.
  • On narrow web use document/score tabs with persistent learner, receipt and question context; no native application parity is implied.
Accessibility
  • Question selector labels include question ID and review state; document page tags have a list/text equivalent.
  • Score labels include maximum; invalid score focuses its field. Every meaningful annotation has text; announce saves per question without changing document focus.
Data
  • Read immutable receipt/pages/tags and pinned question/rubric versions; write held review revisions separately.
  • Score source, manual override reason, reviewer, confirmed save and completion are distinct. Recheck TA learner/question expiry on each read/write; no full-roster preload.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Question selector updates document tags, rubric and comment panel together.
  • Manual overrides survive rubric-rule recalculation.
  • A failed save cannot mark a review complete or change the learner's released view.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
